From: Seller support <support@example-shop.com>
Subject: About your PayPal dispute

Dear buyer, please cancel the dispute. PayPal does not require any dispute before the refund. Orders cannot be refunded in a disputed state. We will arrange a refund for you after the dispute is resolved. Best wishes

From: Seller support <support@example-shop.com>
Subject: About your PayPal dispute

Dear buyer, please cancel the dispute. PayPal requires no dispute to refund. The order cannot be refunded under dispute status. After the dispute is cancelled, we will arrange a refund for you.

From: Seller support <support@example-shop.com>
Subject: About your PayPal dispute

Could you pls kindly close the case firstly,then we refund you immediately via our Paypal ? ’Cause the case open, the ebay system don’t support to refund. The only way we can refund during case open is here. And, once we refund you here, the case will close automatically. Please close CASE firstly, we promise to refund you within 2 workdays. Waiting for your soon reply. Best regards, From Li Chenyi

From: Seller support <support@example-shop.com>
Subject: About your PayPal dispute

We are willing to process refund USD 100.81 .But the money has been held by Paypal and there is No partial refund button. So would you like to close the dispute from paypal, then we will assure refund within 72 hours  Otherwise it will need few months for paypal to deal with it. If you agree with me, you could: Log in your Paypal account---enter resolution center---change the status of dispute into closed.

After you close the dispute, please send an email to this email - paypal @*********.com  Then we will process a refund for you.

From: Seller support <support@example-shop.com>
Subject: About your PayPal dispute

I know you are worried, but please believe that I am acting as a representative of paypal.

Please understand, but if we can give you a refund, we will definitely give you the operation immediately, but because there is no partial refund button in the current case, we can't give you a partial refund.

could you please close the dispute then i will request a refund for you and you can receive that within 24 hours.

From: Seller support <support@example-shop.com>
Subject: About your PayPal dispute

Please know if you proceed with a dispute, we would no longer be able to offer any means of compensation on this order and the decision for further compensation will be left to the result of the dispute between our payment processor and PayPal, which could result in zero funds being returned.
